an8.86:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena icchānaṅgalaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
an8.86:1.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
an8.86:1.4: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito icchānaṅgalaṃ anupatto icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
an8.86:1.5: taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato;
an8.86:1.7: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
an8.86:2.1: atha kho icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇa gahapatikā tassā rattiyā accayena pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya yena icchānaṅgalā vanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhaṃsu uccāsaddā mahāsaddā.
an8.86:2.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nāgito bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
an8.86:2.3: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nāgitaṃ āmantesi:
an8.86:2.4: ‘ke pana te nāgita, uccāsaddā mahāsaddā kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilope’ ti?
an8.86:2.5: ete bhante icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā bhagavantaṃyeva uddissa bhikkhusaṅghañcāti.
an8.86:2.6: māhaṃ nāgita, yasena samāgamaṃ, mā ca mayā yaso,
an8.86:2.7: yo kho nāgita, nayimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an8.86:2.8: so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyāti.
an8.86:3.3: yena yenevadāni bhante, bhagavā gamissati, tanninnāva bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
an8.86:3.4: seyyathāpi bhante, thullaphusitake deve vassante yatā ninnaṃ udakāni pavattanti,
an8.86:3.5: evameva kho bhante, yena yenevadāni bhagavā gamissati, tanninnāva bhavissati brāhmaṇā gahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca
an8.86:4.1: māhaṃ nāgita, yasena samāgamaṃ, mā ca mayā yaso.
an8.86:4.2: yo kho nāgita, nayimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī. yassāhaṃ nekkhamma sukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an8.86:4.3: so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyya.
an8.86:5.1: devatāpi kho nāgita, ekaccā nayimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhiniyo assu akicchalābhiniyo akasiralābhiniyo. yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an8.86:5.2: tumhākampi kho nāgita, saṅgamma samāgamma saṅgaṇikavihāraṃ anuyuttānaṃ viharataṃ evaṃ hoti:
an8.86:5.3: nahanūna me āyasmanto imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhino assu, akicchalābhino akasiralābhino, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
an8.86:5.4: tathā hi paname āyasmanto saṅgamma samāgamma saṅgaṇika vihāraṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
an8.86:6.1: idhāhaṃ nāgita, bhikkhu passāmi aññamaññaṃ aṅgulipatodakehi sañjagghante saṅkīḷante.
an8.86:6.3: nahanūname āyasmanto imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhino akicchalābhino assu akasiralābhino yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an8.86:6.4: tathā hi paname āyasmanto aññamaññaṃ aṅgulipatodakehi sañjagghanti saṅkīḷanti.
an8.86:7.1: idhāhaṃ nāgita, bhikkhu passāmi yāvaatthaṃ udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutte viharante.
an8.86:7.3: nahanūna me āyasmanto imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhino assu akicchalābhino akasiralābhino yassāhaṃ nekkhamma sukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ, akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an8.86:7.4: tathā hi me āyasmanto yāvadatthaṃ udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
an8.86:8.1: idhāhaṃ nāgita, bhikkhuṃ passāmi gāmantavihāriṃ samāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ,
an8.86:8.3: idāni imaṃ āyasmantaṃ ārāmiko vā paccessati samaṇuddeso vā, taṃ tamhā samādhimhā cāvessatīti.
an8.86:8.4: tenāhaṃ nāgita tassa bhikkhuno na attamano homi gāmantavihārena.
an8.86:9.1: idha panāhaṃ nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññakaṃ āraññe pacalāyamānaṃ nisinnaṃ.
an8.86:9.3: idāni ayaṃ āyasmā imaṃ niddākilamathaṃ paṭivinodetvā araññasaññaṃ yeva manasikarissati ekattanti:
an8.86:9.4: tenāhaṃ nāgita tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena.
an8.86:10.1: idha panāhaṃ nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññakaṃ araññe asamāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ.
an8.86:10.3: idāni ayamāyasmā asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samādahissati, samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ anurakkhissatīti.
an8.86:10.4: tenāhaṃ nāgita tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena.
an8.86:11.1: idha panāhaṃ nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññakaṃ araññe samāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ.
an8.86:11.3: idāni ayamāyasmā avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuccissati, vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ anurakkhissatīti.
an8.86:11.4: tenāhaṃ nāgita tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena.
an8.86:14.1: yasmāhaṃ nāgita samaye addhānamaggapaṭipanno na kañci passāmi purato vā pacchato vā, phāsu me nāgita tasmiṃ samaye hoti antamaso uccārapassāvakammāyāti.
